title: Work IQ: agents select the most relevant skills for each request
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap targets and distinguishes documented package controls and Work IQ billing from unconfirmed feature-specific details. Both admin paths and Graph operations are supported; add the package resource reference for the availability value used in the example.
